keyPoints: Mishrit bhinn ko anuchit bhinn me badlo: 2(3/4) = 11/4 — poorn ank x har + ansh, neeche wahi har.
Bhinnon ke jod-ghata me har asaman ho to LCM lo: 2/3 + 3/4 = 8/12 + 9/12 = 17/12 = 1(5/12).
Bhinn x purn sankhya me ansh se guna karo: 3 x 2/5 = 6/5; bhinn x bhinn me ansh x ansh, har x har.
Bhinn me bhaag ke liye bhajak ko palto (reciprocal) aur guna karo: 4/5 ÷ 2/3 = 4/5 x 3/2 = 12/10 = 6/5.
Dashamlav x 10, 100, 1000 me bindu dayen khisakta hai: 2.35 x 100 = 235; bhaag me bindu bayen khisakta hai.
Dashamlav ka guna: 1.2 x 1.3 me pehle 12 x 13 = 156, phir kul 2 dashamlav sthan gin kar 1.56.
Aam galti: bhinn jodte samay ansh aur har alag-alag jod dena (1/2 + 1/3 = 2/5 galat hai) — hamesha pehle har same karo.
subject: Maths
title: Bhinn aur Dashamlav: Sankriyaen
